summary: One request removed people from a campaign, which cancels their open work there: the line counts what happened to its items and names the people it removed.

removed.description: Items that took a member out of the campaign.

not_member.description: Items naming a person the campaign never held.

already_excluded.description: Items naming a person already removed from the campaign.

rejected.description: Items refused, each answered with its error in the response.

contact_ids.description: The people removed, in the order of the request; empty when nobody was.
